name: slipstream
description: Turn folders and tags into a continuous, draggable card stream for effortless long-form writing.
author: gua

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:release
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
